title: Guinness Atkinson CEO：首只被动ETF押注韩妆，零售热情为何高涨？
speaker: Jim Atkinson

segments.en: But if you look at the whole ecosystem, particularly the bigger brands, the manufacturers, the aesthetic companies, they've all got a huge advantage. And they're able to exploit that. And like I said, they're runway globally as massive.
segments.zh: 但纵观整个生态，尤其是大品牌、制造商、美妆公司，它们都有巨大优势，并能加以利用。如我所说，全球增长空间巨大。

segments.en: So Jim, this marks your six ETF into your mention. This is your first passive ETF. Where do you see investors to man across all of your ETFs? And are you seeing an increase in active ETFs?
segments.zh: Jim，这是你提到的第六只ETF，也是首只被动型ETF。你认为市场参与者会如何配置你的ETF？主动型ETF需求在增长吗？

segments.en: Active ETFs are very popular. The reason we decided to do this passive was because we didn't think we had the expertise to go manage this or the manpower.
segments.zh: 主动型ETF很受欢迎。我们选择被动型，是因为自认缺乏管理专长或人力。

segments.en: So we said, well, hang on. We want to get this product in the marketplace. We really love the story. We've done the research. How do we sort of get this out there? And we felt passive was the way to go here.
segments.zh: 我们想把这个产品推向市场，看好这个主题，也做了研究。如何推出？我们认为被动型是合适路径。

segments.en: And then in terms of your client base, where do you think you'll see the most demand for this product?
segments.zh: 就客户基础而言，你认为该产品最大需求来自哪里？

segments.en: Initially, it's going to be retail. The retail excitement around this idea is quite large. And I'll just give you an example.
segments.zh: 初期主要是零售端。零售市场参与者对这个主题热情很高，我举个例子。

segments.en: Our number one most traffic page on our website is our KBTY page by far. And that's been building for weeks heading up in the launch. And today our traffic was greater than it's ever been.
segments.zh: 我们网站流量最高的页面是KBTY页面，遥遥领先。数周来流量持续上升，今日流量创历史新高。

segments.en: And that's because people are very excited about this story.
segments.zh: 这是因为人们对该主题非常兴奋。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, obviously there's there's there's K pop and then there's there's K beauty. I mean, is there any any sort of risk to this whole K beauty sort of story? You think Jim?
segments.zh: 有K-pop也有K-beauty。Jim，你认为整个K-beauty主题是否存在风险？

segments.en: Well, I understand the question. You can say anything in fashion is a trend, right? But if you look at what's actually going on underneath the surface in this industry, they have built a real large amount of infrastructure.
segments.zh: 我理解这个问题。时尚界一切皆趋势，但若看行业底层，它们已建立大量基础设施。

segments.en: And I'll give you an example. They passed a cosmetics act in 1999. And that said, you've got to have safe and effective ingredients in your products. And then a whole infrastructure built around that.
segments.zh: 我举个例子。他们在1999年通过了化妆品法案，规定产品成分必须安全有效，并围绕此建立了整套体系。

segments.en: So what you end up with is safe and effective products that are cheaper than what you might get from other cosmetic companies. And the whole thing is just taken off virally on social media.
segments.zh: 最终你得到的是安全有效的产品，价格还比其他化妆品公司便宜。整个事情在社交媒体上病毒式传播。

segments.en: And now that is starting to move into the stores here in the United States. But it's also in Europe, Latin America, India.
segments.zh: 现在这开始进入美国门店，也拓展到欧洲、拉美和印度。

segments.en: I mean, this is a very popular product line industry. And it's got a lot of runway to go.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常受欢迎的产品线行业，还有很大的增长空间。
